title: Accounting issues after underlying asset change
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, because the accounting would go wrong for multiple scenarios  **Likelihood:** Medium, because it would happen when admin calls `changeAsset()`  ## Description  In general updating underlying asset is very risky move in a pool. All the cached prices will be wrong.  In the current code we have two cached prices(that I know of): In requestRedeem() code caches pool prices for requests.
